meta.name: company-research
meta.description: Create a company research brief with executive quotes, product strategy, and org context. Use when preparing for interviews, competitive analysis, partnerships, or market-entry work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成含高管引述与战略分析的公司研究简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在面试或合作前快速了解一家公司的战略与背景。
copy.tagline_en: Generate a company research brief with executive quotes and product strategy.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick company insights for interviews or partnerships.

howto.what: Claude 能根据公开信息生成公司研究简报，包含高管引述、产品策略、组织架构和未来规划。
howto.when: 当你需要准备面试、竞争分析、合作伙伴评估或市场进入研究时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一份关于 Stripe 的产品策略和高管观点简报。
say.note: 生成公司简报，包含高管引述和产品策略。

say.text: 研究一下 Shopify 的竞争分析，重点看产品路线图。
say.note: 输出竞争分析相关的产品策略和未来规划。

say.text: 分析特斯拉的组织架构对产品管理的影响。
say.note: 探索组织动态和 PM 角色。

howto.what_en: Claude creates a company research brief with executive quotes, product strategy, org context, and future roadmap from public sources.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to prepare for interviews, competitive analysis, partnership evaluation, or market-entry research.

say_en.text: Create a brief on Stripe's product strategy and executive insights.
say_en.note: Generates a company profile with quotes and strategy.

say_en.text: Research Shopify's competitive landscape, focusing on product roadmap.
say_en.note: Outputs competitive analysis with product plans.

say_en.text: Analyze Tesla's org structure impact on product management.
say_en.note: Explores organizational dynamics and PM role.
